caption: The drawing depicts a teapot viewed from the side, rendered in black and gray pencil on a light-colored background. The teapot has a hexagonal body with ornate detailing on its front and top surfaces, including floral and scroll patterns. It features a large, curved, dark handle on the left and a long, thin spout extending to the right. The teapot stands on three short feet. Above and to the left of the teapot, there is a rectangular inset showing a close-up detail of the floral border used on the teapot. Above and to the right, there is another rectangular inset showing a close-up of the central crest or cartouche ornament on the teapot’s body, which contains script letters and elaborate drapery. The drawing is signed "G. Capelli" at the lower right corner.
title: Silver Teapot with Tray
